Subject: Renewal roadmap demo — stitch + stagger proposal (run-of-show ask)

Hi Emily — great to be lining this up.

Congrats again on the contract renewal — excited to make the roadmap session useful for both product and ops audiences. Two quick asks as we lock a slot:

1) We propose a staggered format (35m product walkthrough + 20m deep-dive for engineering & procurement) so execs can join just the first block while engineers stay for the tech portion. Would that work for your stakeholders?

2) Can you confirm preferred time windows next week (PST) and whether recording is allowed? We’ll dial in a run-of-show and hand over a short pre-read.

I’ve CC'd Marissa (ops/runbook owner) and Stephanie (legal/contract questions) so we can align on logistics and any procurement pre-reqs.

Proposed slots (PST) — pick one or counter:
- Tue May 4: 10:00–11:00
- Wed May 5: 13:00–14:00
- Thu May 6: 09:00–10:00

If none of those work, tell us a 90-minute window and we’ll stitch the schedule to fit. I’ll attach a draft run-of-show and attendee matrix after you confirm the slot.

Thanks — Jordan
Jordan Blake | Account Exec | Redwood Inference

Attachments: (will send run_of_show_v3.pdf + attendee_matrix_ACME.csv once slot confirmed)

Thanks Jordan — quick reply from my side.

The staggered format makes sense. Leadership prefers to join the first 40 minutes; engineering wants a focused deep-dive after that. Recording is OK for internal use (no external publication).

Best windows for our group (PST):
- Wed May 5: 12:30–14:00 (pref)
- Thu May 6: 08:30–10:00 (alternate)

We’ll have: me (Product sponsor), Priya Rao (Platform PM), and Alex Chen (Infra lead). Procurement looped in for any pre-reqs — they asked whether you can share:
- final run-of-show and slide deck
- a single-sheet on data handling (to satisfy our security gating)

If you can send the run-of-show + attendee matrix by EOD Tues Apr 27, Procurement will triage any items ahead of time.

Emily
